BS01.desc: Instantly teleports 400 units in the target direction, stopping short of walls.
BS02.desc: Removes all crowd control effects and grants crowd control immunity for 1.5 seconds.
BS03.desc: Restores 15% HP to yourself and the ally with the lowest HP% within 800 units, and grants both +20% move speed for 2 seconds.
BS04.desc: Grants a shield equal to 20% of max HP for 3 seconds.
BS05.desc: Deals 600 + 40 × level true damage to an enemy minion or monster within 500 units. Required to buy Jungle items.
BS07.desc: Burns an enemy hero within 600 units for 70 + 20 × level true damage over 5 seconds and reduces their healing by 50%.
BS08.desc: Become stealthed for 1.5 seconds and gain +25% move speed.
BS09.desc: After a 3-second channel, teleports to a chosen allied tower or your fountain. Taking damage interrupts the channel.
BS10.desc: Slows an enemy hero within 650 units by 40% and reduces their damage dealt by 30% for 2.5 seconds.
BS11.desc: Deals 150 + 30 × level true damage plus 25% of the target's missing HP to an enemy hero within 600 units.
BS13.desc: Stuns enemy heroes within 450 units for 0.8 seconds, then slows them by 30% for 1.5 seconds.
BS14.desc: Fires a flame bolt up to 700 units in a direction. The first enemy hero hit takes 100 + 20 × level magic damage and is knocked back.
BS15.desc: For 5 seconds, takes 30% less damage and reflects 35% of damage taken to the attacker as true damage.
EQ101.desc:
Armor Buster: +30% physical penetration (does not stack with other Armor Buster items).
Malefic Energy: +12% basic attack range. Basic attack hits grant +10% move speed for 0.5s.
EQ102.desc: After casting the ultimate, gain +30% move speed for 7.5s (15s cooldown).
EQ103.desc:
Lifebane: Dealing damage reduces the target's shield and HP regen effects by 40% for 3s.
Punish: Deal 8% more damage to enemy heroes with more extra HP than you.
EQ104.desc:
Dragon Scale: Every 4 extra physical attack grants 1 hybrid defense (up to 50). Halved for non-fighters.
Lifeline: When damage from an enemy hero drops you below 30% HP, gain a shield of 120 × level and +50% move speed decaying over 3s (60s cooldown).
EQ105.desc: Damaging the same enemy hero or monster 5 times in a row grants +50% move speed decaying over 3s (8s cooldown).
EQ106.desc: Damaging a non-minion enemy below 50% HP grants +25% physical attack for 2s (applies to that hit).
EQ107.desc: After 5s without dealing or taking hero damage, the next basic attack deals 160 (+40% total physical attack) extra physical damage and slows by 40% for 1.5s.
EQ108.desc: Every 5s (−0.2s per basic attack, min 2s), the next basic attack also hits up to 3 nearby enemies for 150–362 magic damage (scales with attack speed). Can crit; double damage to minions.
EQ109.desc: After casting a skill, the next basic attack within 3s deals extra true damage equal to 60% total physical attack and restores 80 (+40% total physical attack) HP (1.5s cooldown).
EQ110.desc: Critical basic attacks deal extra true damage equal to 12% of the damage before reduction.
EQ111.desc: Critical hits grant +20% attack speed for 2s.
EQ112.desc:
Armor Buster: +30% physical penetration (does not stack with other Armor Buster items).
Breaker: +0.1% physical penetration per point of the target's physical defense (up to +30%).
EQ113.desc: (Active) Freeze for 2s: untargetable and immune to damage, but unable to move or cast (100s cooldown).
EQ114.desc: Kills and assists cut the ultimate's remaining cooldown by 30%.
EQ115.desc: Damaging an enemy hero below 4% HP executes them (ignores shields). Kills grant 10 Lethality stacks (max 80), each +0.1% threshold; lose 30% of stacks on death.
EQ116.desc: Dealing damage grants +12 physical attack for 4s, once per second (up to 6 stacks, +72). At full stacks, deal extra true damage equal to 10% of damage dealt. Halved for marksmen, mages and supports.
EQ117.desc: (Active) Become immune to physical damage for 2s (1s for non-marksmen; 90s cooldown).
EQ118.desc:
Swift: Each 1% extra crit chance becomes +1% attack speed (you can no longer crit).
Endless Strike: After every 2 non-crit basic attacks, the next one gains +80% attack speed and triggers attack effects 2 extra times.
EQ119.desc:
Corrosive: Basic attacks deal 80 extra physical damage and slow by 8% for 1.5s (halved for ranged; stacks 5 times).
Impulse: Basic attacks grant +6% attack speed for 3s (up to 5 stacks, +30%).
EQ120.desc:
Engulf: Basic attacks deal extra physical damage equal to 8% of the target's current HP (max 60 against minions).
Devour: Each basic attack restores 10 (+4 × level) HP (halved against minions).
EQ121.desc: When you drop below 30% HP, gain a shield of 60 × level and +50% move speed decaying over 3s (60s cooldown).
EQ126.desc:
Crossbow: Basic attacks deal 40 extra adaptive damage.
Impulse: Basic attacks grant +3% attack speed for 3s (up to 5 stacks, +15%).
EQ134.desc: Used on purchase: +30 physical attack and +15% lifesteal for 120s. Takes no slot; only one potion effect at a time.
EQ201.desc: For every 900 magic damage dealt to enemy heroes (before reduction), summon a butterfly that deals magic damage equal to 8% of the target's current HP (min 50).
EQ202.desc: +12% healing effect (unique). Healing or shielding an ally below 35% HP also gives them a shield of 100 × level for 3s and cuts your skill cooldowns by 2s (once per 60s per ally).
EQ203.desc: +10 magic penetration (unique). Magic damage to an enemy hero lowers its magic defense by 2.5 (+0.5 × level) for 2s (stacks 3 times).
EQ204.desc: Every 6s, the next damaging skill deals 255 (+85% total magic power) extra magic damage to every enemy it hits.
EQ205.desc: Gain a shield of 800 (+100% total magic power), restored 20s after you last took damage. +30 move speed while it holds; +150 move speed for 1s when it breaks.
EQ206.desc: After casting a skill, the next basic attack within 3s deals 90 (+60% total magic power) extra true damage and slows by 15% for 1.5s (1.5s cooldown).
EQ207.desc:
Scorch: Magic damage burns the target for 3s, dealing magic damage equal to 1% of its max HP per second.
Lifebane: Dealing damage reduces the target's shield and HP regen effects by 40% for 3s.
EQ208.desc: Skill damage to an enemy hero slows it by 10% for 2s (stacks 3 times, 30%).
EQ209.desc: +20% hybrid lifesteal (unique). Dealing magic damage grants +5 magic power (up to 6 stacks, +30; once per 0.4s). At full stacks, magic damage dealt is increased by 12% for 5s.
EQ210.desc: Total magic power +21–35% (+1% per hero level).
EQ211.desc: +40% magic penetration (unique). +0.1% magic penetration per point of the target's magic defense (up to +20%).
EQ212.desc:
Destiny: Magic damage to an enemy hero grants 4.5 (+0.5 × level) hybrid defense for 5s (up to 6 stacks; once per 0.4s).
Gift: Dropping below 50% HP restores 15% max HP over 3s; dropping below 50% mana restores 15% max mana over 3s (60s cooldown).
EQ213.desc:
Affliction: Basic attacks deal 50 (+30% total magic power) extra magic damage.
Impulse: Basic attacks grant +6% attack speed for 3s (up to 5 stacks, +30%).
EQ214.desc:
Mana Spring: Restores 1.5% of max mana per second.
Magic Mastery: Cooldown reduction cap +5% (40% → 45%).
EQ215.desc: Dropping below 50% HP restores 15% max HP over 3s; dropping below 50% mana restores 15% max mana over 3s (60s cooldown).
EQ217.desc: After casting a skill, the next basic attack within 3s deals 50 extra true damage (1.5s cooldown).
EQ225.desc: Used on purchase: +30 magic power and +10% cooldown reduction for 120s. Takes no slot; only one potion effect at a time.
EQ301.desc: Taking magic damage grants 5 (+1 × level) magic defense for 5s (up to 6 stacks; once per 0.4s).
EQ302.desc:
Chastise: Taking damage lowers the attacker's attack speed by 25% for 2s.
Redemption: When damage drops you below 30% HP, recover 20% max HP over 2s (60s cooldown).
EQ303.desc: Dealing damage grants +8 adaptive attack and +2% move speed for 4s, once per second (up to 6 stacks). At full stacks, gain +25% CC reduction.
EQ304.desc: On death, revive after 2.5s with 16% max HP and a shield of 150 (+70 × level) for 3s (210s cooldown).
EQ305.desc:
Fortress Shield: +8 hybrid defense per enemy hero within 5 units (up to +40).
Lifebane: Enemies within 5 units have their shield and HP regen effects reduced by 40%.
EQ306.desc: Taking magic damage from an enemy hero's skill or basic attack reduces magic damage taken by 25% for 3s (including that hit). Recharges 5s after leaving combat.
EQ307.desc: Shield and HP regen effects received +25%.
EQ308.desc: When hit by an enemy skill, the attacker's physical damage is reduced by 6% for 2s (up to 3 stacks).
EQ309.desc:
Recovery: After 5s out of combat, recover 2.5% of max HP per second.
Defender: When a single hit deals more than 500 damage, recover (30 + 0.3% of max HP)% of the excess as HP.
EQ310.desc:
Burning Soul: Deal magic damage equal to 1.2% of your max HP per second to nearby enemies; +125% (+15% × level) against minions and monsters.
Curse: Burning Soul damage lowers the target's hybrid defense by 3 for 3s (up to 3 stacks).
EQ311.desc: Every 4s, the next basic attack deals 50 (+100% extra physical defense) (+100% extra magic defense) true damage to the target and nearby enemies and briefly slows them by 99%. Each enemy hero hit permanently grants +1 hybrid defense. Halved for marksmen, mages and assassins.
EQ312.desc:
Demonize: When enemy hero damage drops you below 40% HP, gain 30% damage reduction for 3s and cut skill cooldowns by 2s (60s cooldown).
Defiance: +0.25% damage dealt per 1% HP lost (up to +15%).
EQ313.desc: +20% crit damage reduction (unique). When hit by a basic attack, deal (30 + 2% of total physical defense)% of the damage taken (before reduction) back to the attacker as physical damage and slow them by 15% for 1s.
EQ315.desc: When hit by an enemy skill, the attacker's physical damage is reduced by 4% for 2s (up to 3 stacks).
EQ316.desc: +4 hybrid defense per enemy hero within 5 units (up to +20).
EQ318.desc: Deal magic damage equal to 0.6% of your max HP per second to nearby enemies; +125% (+15% × level) against minions and monsters.
EQ325.desc: Used on purchase: +500 max HP and +5% damage reduction for 120s. Takes no slot; only one potion effect at a time.
EQ401.desc: Killing or assisting on an enemy minion restores 4% of max mana.
EQ406.desc: Crowd control and slows on you last 25% shorter.
EQ407.desc: Taking physical damage grants +4 physical defense for 3s (up to 5 stacks, +20).
